notes: Live-tunable settings for the running page. THE SHIPPED VALUES ARE THE MEASURED ONES: marquee speeds are px per second read off https://ffcdentalclinic.com on 2026-09-06 (.sm-track for media, .kb-track for text), at 1440 wide and at 390 wide. Editing this file changes the DEFAULT. The studio changes what Jarich is looking at RIGHT NOW without a reload, by writing a partial to localStorage['dsd:settings'] and dispatching window 'dsd:settings'. Nothing is persisted back here WHILE HE IS DRAGGING: pressing Save in the studio writes this file through its own file route, keeping the previous version beside it as settings.json.bak, and it still has to be committed like any other content. Save MERGES only the `marquee` key over what is already here and writes the whole object back, so anything added to this file later survives a Save untouched. 'wide' applies above the narrow breakpoint (700px), 'narrow' at or below it. 'overrides' is keyed by a track's data-marquee id and wins over its family: leave it empty unless one strip genuinely needs to differ, because a per-track speed is a thing to keep in step forever.
